Name: Promise Hemsley, The Thread Wizard

Voice: 5'6 human male, brown eyes that are almost red, long brown hair that goes just down to his shoulders,

Description: long black hair, blueish gold eye, and a pair of circular framed glasses. Wears a set of brown traveling clothes and a heavy wool scarf. His belt carries multiple small spell books bearing different colored leather covers and a wooden spellcasting wand.

Important Info: Child of [[Kairos]], basically Ivys, doesn't know who his father was. Wizard who studied at the Moonshadow Academy. He specializes in gravity and relative magics. Close friend of [[Lorne]] and mentor to [[Juno]].
